I farm here in the North East, and this maize plot of 2.59 hectares is rented, so I am careful not to put too much money into land that is not mine. Still, maize needs fertilizer to give a proper harvest on these tired savanna soils, so I will buy what I can — maybe four bags of NPK and two bags of urea if the subsidy bags come through the cooperative. I will use improved seed because the agro-dealer in town had good ones last year and my neighbor Musa got a better cob size from them. I cannot irrigate here — this plot depends on the rains from June — and I will spray once against the armyworm because last season it ate through two of my neighbors' fields badly.
